payload.title: Migrate Cyclotron marketing delivery to production account
payload.description:
Move cyclotron.anth.us from the legacy AWS account to cyclotron-production through a parallel, verified static-site and AWS CodePipeline deployment. Keep the legacy site live until the target distribution, private-repository connection, source/build/deploy evidence, and rollback path are verified.

Definition of Done:
- The target account owns the site bucket, CloudFront distribution, certificate, and least-privilege pipeline.
- The GitHub connection is scoped only to AnthusAI/Cyclotron-web.
- A main revision completes Source, Build, and Deploy in the target account.
- DNS changes only cyclotron.anth.us after target verification; legacy remains rollback until an explicit cleanup decision.
- No whole-zone migration, broad cross-account role, or legacy connection activation is introduced.
